hypotheses: Observed entrances and region visits can improve long-horizon regional access and reduce backtracking.
Category-conditioned structural inference can improve observation along routes to a shared target.
Combining the two layers can improve the final map at a fixed charged action budget.
units_and_pairing: Building is the independent reporting unit. Launch five separate first-frame actors from the same observed packet and heading per building. The first four arms vary the global region switch and local G versus correct-category S structural prior only. Both local priors use the same frozen visibility predictor and auxiliary weights. F_strict is the published nearest-reachable-frontier selector, retaining its realized navigation. All runs own their new observations. Charge all rotations, translation and return. All declared buildings and attempts stay in evidence.
regional_features: Observed occupation, footprint-certified entrance/frontier poses, native feasible return, observed region visitation, remaining frontier, visible unknown and dispatched-goal repetition. No object category, no ground-truth door, room graph or mesh enters regional ranking. Local S takes only currently observed, supplied ideal simulator instance categories, with the shared measured layer and structural posterior support. See frozen policy files for exact metric constants and tie order.
budgets_and_capacity: A cold return-support geometry check shows that every registered room is individually reachable and returnable inside 192 actions at the frozen footprint. The long corridor can be more demanding for full coverage and remains in the matrix. Keep 192 for every arm. Resource cap: first batch four buildings and up to five one-thread whole-floor workers on the eight-core Jetson. Local controlled study may use two other one-thread workers. No automatic enlargement of the frozen set. Additional predictors, external methods and expansion require a separately registered experiment.
failure_and_time: Native terminal or guard-induced early completion is retained at actual stop and its achieved map is the endpoint. Later unexecuted check clocks are missing. If lost before a valid endpoint, report failure, last valid map whenever available and completion count. Retry only documented technical interruptions with an unchanged frozen configuration. Keep logs, process status, original receipts and subset metrics. Record native task wall-clock and per-paid-command planner latency. For real replans separately summarize decision callbacks associated with newly dispatched options, noting that an action callback can contain guard-triggered replanning. Medians/P95 on the actual sample ledger, including behavior of tied policies.
measurement: C_free = sensor-observed correct free cells / fixed reachable true free cells. Use native independent visible-reference surface F1 at 5 cm for the actual sensor-only TSDF, and J=C_free×F1 with both in [0,1]. A95 is first actual paid clock C_free>=0.95. Repeated distance is the metric length of translated grid edges traversed after the first traversal in either direction, with return separated where possible. Cross-region time uses actual positions and evaluator-only original region bounds; rotations and sensor-only coverage that never cross do not count. Distinguish macro considered, selected, first authorized dispatch, true position and heading reached, guarded and unexecuted. Pairwise absolute and signed changes are transparent; missing events stay unknown, never padded to an action clock.
contrasts: original_S - original_G (local prior in original global)
region_S - region_G (local prior in regional global)
average of the two global effects
difference between the two local effects (interaction)

registered_descriptive_rules.map: Map effect of engineering interest requires ΔJ>0.005 in at least three of four buildings with none <-0.005. The 0.5 percentage-point threshold retains the magnitude used in the prior 192-step study. Interpret positive or adverse individual outcomes without a significance claim.
registered_descriptive_rules.global_motion: A difference of 4 charged actions to first new-room entry or 0.40 m prior-edge travel at task stop is engineering-scale. Also report every actual raw difference and cases where only one arm achieved a crossing. Evaluate global access and repeated travel as separate outcomes.
registered_descriptive_rules.safety: Keep returns, extra collision events, native stops and unfinished denominator visible. A higher J does not override safety or failure records. No selected building or statistic can be replaced based on outcomes. Report per-building paired results, arithmetic mean and minimum-to-maximum of each contrast.
